title: Worker view heap finish
summary: At 0x42c8c0, repeatedly move the max-heap root to the shrinking range end and restore the heap using signed priorities at item offset 0x188. The caller at 0x42c3f1 constructs the heap first. The original internal convention passes first in ECX, last in EDX and a forwarded unused word on the caller-cleaned stack.
test_description: Direct oracle comparisons for lengths 0 through 64 with randomized heaps, duplicate and extreme signed keys, equal keys, and arbitrary non-heap inputs. Compare every pointer slot including guards, all item bytes, and the installed FS head after each original call; check heap inputs produce ascending priorities and vary the forwarded word.
known_limits: The item type, meaning of its priority and forwarded context remain unresolved.
The interface models valid aligned pointer ranges and practical heap sizes; invalid, unaligned, reversed or overflowing ranges are not modeled.
The portable interface expresses the internal register convention semantically; the test uses GCC i386 regparm for the oracle.
No matching machine-code claim is made.
